name: Gold Peony Fashion Shoot
image_purpose: high-end lookbook and line-sheet hero image

prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic high-fashion editorial image for a modernized Chinese-style and cyberpunk-inspired lookbook.
prompt.main_subject: An adult East Asian woman with refined, cool facial features and smooth deep-brown hair casually coiled with a few loose strands. She wears a deep-brown and black silk halter top embroidered with intricate golden peonies and traditional floral patterns, a wide black butterfly-shaped embroidered stand collar, a slender metal necklace, matching long embroidered sleeves, and a delicate waist chain.
prompt.composition_elements: Mid-shot half-body portrait, detached yet graceful expression, visible collarbone and realistic skin texture, minimalist blurred gray concrete background with subtle crack textures.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Delicate scattered natural light softly outlines the face and collarbone; sophisticated antique bronze, deep chocolate brown, ink black, and champagne-gold palette; cool industrial atmosphere with luxurious visual tension.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic cinematic texture, extremely rich textile and embroidery detail, editorial composition, sharp subject focus, natural proportions.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A highly elegant adult East Asian woman in a refined and cool mid-shot portrait, deep-brown hair casually coiled with loose strands, wearing a modernized Chinese-style halter top in deep brown and black silk with intricate golden peony embroidery, traditional floral patterns, a wide black butterfly-shaped stand collar, necklace, matching long embroidered sleeves, and a delicate waist chain. Detached yet graceful expression, soft scattered natural light, realistic skin texture and silk sheen, blurred gray cracked concrete background, antique bronze, chocolate brown, ink black, and champagne-gold palette, hyper-realistic cinematic high-fashion editorial.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers, oversmoothed skin, harsh plastic texture, messy embroidery, watermark, logo, text, signature, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the adult subject's overall styling, outfit construction, embroidery, palette, pose, and industrial environment for consistency. Keep the identity fictional and replaceable; do not infer a public figure. Preserve outfit, product-free branding, logo-free wardrobe, environment, and typography-free presentation.
